sections.title: Basics
sections.summary: Run flow, rooms, rewards, and the character sheet.

sections.title: Combat
sections.summary: Board rules, timing, defenses, hazards, and card flow.

sections.title: Keywords
sections.summary: Card and enemy terms unlocked as they appear.

sections.title: Magicks
sections.summary: Magic cards recorded when they are gained, offered, or seen in combat.

sections.title: Equipment
sections.summary: Weapons, armor, trinkets, and other gear recorded when discovered.

sections.title: Items
sections.summary: Single-use scavenger cards recorded when carried or offered.

sections.title: Creatures
sections.summary: Enemies recorded the first time they are seen.

entries.title: The Run
body: One journey through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon.
Explore rooms, win combats and claim rewards before the next boss. Held Embers stay with the run until banked, spent, recovered or lost. The run ends at the last dragon, at defeat or by Embrace.

entries.title: Map and Rooms
body: Revealed exits show where you can travel next. Rooms you leave are sealed behind you.

Combat, Ember Hearth, merchant, treasure, relic, and boss rooms each change the next choice. Each section is a map of rooms. Pick a forward route through combat, Relic, Scavenger, Ember Hearth and other rooms.

entries.title: Character
body: Your loadout includes equipment, magic, items, relics and skills.
Equipment, magic and items form your deck. Change your loadout outside combat, including at an Ember Hearth.

entries.title: Rewards
body: After combat, take 1 of 3 cards, or skip to heal 3.
Dragons and Guardians also give relics. A magic card you gain goes straight into your deck. Purge removes a card.

entries.title: Relics
body: Passive effects that last the whole run.
Relics come from Relic rooms, dragons and Guardians. Hover a relic badge in the top HUD to see that relic's current text.

entries.title: Combat Board
body: The 9×9 grid where combat happens.

Cards target board tiles. Each legal target meets the card's Range, line of sight, occupancy and terrain rules. Card previews show legal targets, affected tiles and projected results. Press Z to undo free Movement before you play a card. Movement that reveals or triggers something cannot be undone. Each enemy shows the damage of its next attack and its place in the turn order. Red tiles will be hit before your next turn. Press I to see each enemy's full plan.

entries.title: Turn Clock
body: The unit with the lowest Time acts next, and you act first on a tie.
Playing a card adds the card's Time to the acting unit's turn delay. A beat is a battlefield rule's slot on the turn rail.

entries.title: Card Play
body: Spend 1 Card Play per card, refilling each turn and gaining 1 per kill.
Extra Card Plays expire at the end of your turn. The Card Plays counter shows your remaining Card Plays this turn.

entries.title: Health and Defenses
body: Damage hits Block, then Stoneskin, then Health.
Pierce skips Block and Stoneskin.

entries.title: Defiance
body: Each Defiance charge saves you from 1 lethal hit and leaves you at 25% of your maximum Health, rounded up.
Gain 1 Defiance per 4 permanent levels at the start of a run. Reaching a milestone during a run adds the new charge. Defiance does not refill during a run.

entries.title: Targeting
body: Attacks need a visible target within Range. Ranged attacks also need line of sight. A card that ignores Range or line of sight says so.

Walls and Outcrops block the line of sight required by ranged attacks. Area actions hit the tiles shown in the preview. Push and Pull move the target from or toward the source until the target reaches the distance or stops.

entries.title: Fatigue
body: Drawing from an empty draw pile shuffles your discard into your draw pile and costs Health.
Each Fatigue in a combat costs 1 more Health than the last. Fatigue bypasses Block. Draw and Pass previews show the Health that Fatigue costs.

entries.title: Traps
body: Traps hit when entered or attacked.
A trap leaves the trap's element as ground. An Air trap Pushes each adjacent unit 1 tile away instead of leaving ground.

entries.title: Outcrops
body: An Outcrop blocks movement and line of sight.

Raise Outcrops on empty floor. When an Outcrop is destroyed, leave Rubble on that tile. Raising an Outcrop keeps routes connected. Outcrops raised on tiles adjacent to the target may close off the target tile. A powder keg blocks movement and leaves line of sight open. When the keg is destroyed, the keg Bursts and can destroy other kegs. When Rockburst hits an Outcrop or crate, Rockburst Bursts that terrain. Worldbreak Bursts an adjacent Outcrop you raised.

entries.title: Lightning Strikes
body: This enemy hits each Marked tile, then leaves Electrified on each Marked tile.

entries.title: Summon
body: This enemy adds the named enemy to combat.
The summon preview shows each arrival. The summon preview shows Summon blocked when no enemy arrives.

entries.title: The Umbra
body: Darkness that hides enemies and enemy intents.

The Umbra hides tiles beyond your sight. Hidden enemies show no intent and can't be targeted directly. Area attacks still hit hidden enemies in the area. Light reveals tiles within its range. Vision makes hidden enemies visible.

entries.title: Melee
body: Deal X damage to an adjacent target or a target within the card's Range.

entries.title: Ranged
body: Deal X damage to a target within Range and line of sight.

entries.title: Move
body: Walk up to X tiles.
Ground and traps trigger on entry. Choose your tile to stay in place. Leaving Rubble costs 2 Movement instead of 1.

entries.title: Blink
body: Move to a visible open tile up to X tiles away, ignoring intervening tiles.
Ground and traps trigger on arrival. Choose your tile to stay in place. A Gloam Stalker's Fade lands on another adjacent tile if the tile behind you is blocked.

entries.title: Block
body: Block absorbs damage until the start of the holder's next turn.

entries.title: Stoneskin
body: Stoneskin absorbs damage after Block and stays until used up.
Stoneskin ends when combat ends.

entries.title: Heal
body: Restore X Health.
Healing stops at your maximum Health.

entries.title: Draw
body: Draw X cards.
Your hand holds at most 7 cards. The Draw chip shows how many cards you will draw.

entries.title: Card Play
body: Spend 1 Card Play per card, refilling each turn and gaining 1 per kill.
Each enemy summon gives you 1 more Card Play next turn. Killing a summoned enemy gives none.

entries.title: Follow-up
body: Gain the Follow-up bonus if you already played a card this turn.
Follow-up is checked when the card starts. Your hand shows the bonus while Follow-up is active.

entries.title: Empower
body: Pay the Empower cost as you play this card to gain the Empower bonus.

Charge a card with the seal in the upper right, E, or the controller's right stick. A charged card glows until you play that card or your turn ends. Pay the Empower cost after the card resolves. Extra Time delays your next turn. Block does not prevent a Health cost. An Exhaust cost removes this card for the rest of combat.

entries.title: Stagger
body: Delay the target's next turn by X Time.
Hover a Stagger target to preview that target's new place in the turn order. Each unit takes up to 6 Stagger per turn.

entries.title: Illusion
body: A decoy with X Health that enemies target when at least as close as you.

An enemy that damages a charged Illusion takes damage once per attack. Doppelganger lets ranged attacks come from the Illusion's tile. Mirror Feint places an Illusion adjacent to an enemy. Hall of Mirrors creates an Illusion on each empty tile adjacent to you. Empty Husk swaps you with an Illusion and gives that Illusion your Block as extra Health. Shattered Reflection Bursts one of your Illusions. Swap triggers arrival effects, and Burst triggers Illusion destruction effects.

entries.title: Immobilize
body: Immobilized units can't Move, Blink or Swap on their next turn.

entries.title: Exhaust
body: This card leaves your deck until the end of combat.

entries.title: Retaliate
body: Until the holder's next turn, melee hits and hits from adjacent tiles deal X damage back.

Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack. Add Retaliate damage together and use the largest Shock and Push values. Block and Stoneskin absorb Retaliate damage. An enemy defeated by Retaliate gives the usual rewards and no Card Play. An Illusion's Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack.

entries.title: Rite
body: This card's effect lasts for the rest of combat, and this card Exhausts.
With Worldspine, at the start of your turn, each enemy adjacent to an Outcrop you raised takes 3 damage.

entries.title: Health Cost
body: Lose X Health.
Pay the Health cost when the card finishes. Block and Stoneskin don't prevent the loss.

entries.title: Pierce
body: Damage from this attack ignores Block and Stoneskin.

entries.title: Shock
body: Shocked units can't attack on their next turn.
When a card Shocks on each hit, Chain and conducted hits also Shock.

entries.title: Expose
body: The next hit that damages an Exposed unit deals X more damage.

entries.title: Chain
body: After each hit, hit 1 new target within X tiles, with Electrified tiles as relays.
Each enemy is hit at most once by Chain. Lightning cards also hit through connected Electrified tiles.

entries.title: Push
body: Move the target X tiles straight away from the source, causing a Collision if blocked.

A card Push starts from you unless the card names a tile. If the target is diagonal, the longer direction is chosen by default. Rotate to choose the other direction before you commit. In an area Push, each enemy moves straight away from the source and collides if blocked.

entries.title: Pull
body: Move the target X tiles straight toward the source, causing a Collision if blocked.

If the target is diagonal, the longer direction is chosen by default. Rotate to choose the other direction before you commit. A target that reaches the source stops without a Collision. In an area Pull, each enemy moves straight toward the source and collides if blocked.

entries.title: Collision
body: A blocked Push or Pull deals 2 damage per unmoved tile to the mover and blocker.
Walls take no damage. Block and Stoneskin absorb Collision damage.

entries.title: Consume
body: This item leaves your deck for the rest of the run once played.

entries.title: Light
body: Light reveals within X tiles for the rest of combat and gives enemies starting in Light Expose 2.

entries.title: Vision
body: For X turns, each hidden enemy is visible to you.

entries.title: Tunnel Crawler
lore: A hairless, milk-eyed thing bred in the dark beneath the Labyrinth. It hunts by the tremor of footsteps on stone.
It scuttles straight at you and rakes with its claws, or curls up behind its thick hide.

entries.title: Dust Acolyte
lore: A robed skeleton still keeping the rites of an order that once knelt to the dragons. The orb in its hand is packed with the dust of the dead.
It prefers to fight from a distance, hurling bolts of grave dust, warding itself with Block and mending its own bones.

entries.title: Bone Harrier
lore: The bones of a hunter who came into the Labyrinth and never left. The dark stood it back up, spear and all.
It harries you with its spear from range, and its hardest throws punch through Block. It skips back out of reach, or rushes in to stab.

entries.title: Stone Warden
lore: A dead knight raised to guard these halls. It no longer remembers whose watch it keeps, only that no one may leave.
It marches in behind its shield and swings a spiked mace, or stamps down to hit everything beside it. It can also give Block to each other enemy.

entries.title: Cinder Ooze
lore: Slag that crawls the Labyrinth's furnace halls, shaped in the likeness of a fire it has never seen. A cracked crust holds in a core that never cools.
It oozes after you and leaves Fire wherever it strikes, and it soaks up nearby flames to harden its crust. When it dies, it can split into two Cinder Droplets.

entries.title: Cinder Droplet
lore: A burning gobbet of slag, thrown off when a Cinder Ooze dies. It is small, quick and just as hot.
It darts in to spatter you and leaves Fire on your tile, then hisses back behind a thin crust of Block.

entries.title: Shale Bloomer
lore: A flower of living stone, grown where no light has ever reached. Its petals are slate, and its seeds are shards.
It bursts in a spray of flying stone that leaves Rubble around it, and flicks shards that make the next hit on you land harder. It grows Stoneskin, and Rubble beside it makes that skin thicker.

entries.title: Chainbound Gaoler
lore: The Labyrinth's jailer, still walking the rounds of cells no one has left in centuries. It carries a hook on a length of chain for new prisoners.
It hooks you with its chain and drags you in, shackles you in place and batters you up close. It also hides behind Block.

entries.title: Grave Surgeon
lore: A plague doctor's coat with something patient inside it. It stitches up the Labyrinth's dead and sends them back to fight.
It hangs back to heal the other enemies and brace them with Block, and the bracing removes Fire, Ice or Electrified from under them. Up close, it cuts at you with a serrated saw.

entries.title: Frostglass Lancer
lore: Ice given the shape of a knight and set to stand watch in the Rime Hall. Its spear is a single shard of glacier ice.
It drives its spear through a line of tiles and leaves Ice behind, or throws it from range, and its hardest strikes Stagger anyone standing on Ice. It also falls back behind a guard of Block.

entries.title: Zekarion, the Raging Tempest
lore: The storm dragon of the Tempest Spire. Lightning crawls over its scales, and the air around it never settles. In the world outside, people pray to it for rain and curse it for the floods.

Zekarion scatters lightning across the floor and leaves that ground Electrified, then uses Overload to strike everyone standing on it. Between storms, it lashes you with lightning and calls Lightning Wisps to its side.

entries.title: Lightning Wisp
lore: A scrap of thundercloud given a will of its own. Zekarion calls Wisps down to fight for it.
It zips in to sting, charges the ground beneath it with Electrified, and fires arcs that leap along Electrified ground and Shock whoever they reach there.

entries.title: Worldspines
body: Tharokh Marks tiles between you and Tharokh. After every second turn of yours, the Marked tiles become Outcrops. At half Health, Tharokh's Marked tiles become Outcrops after each of your turns.
A Marked tile stays flat if the unit on that tile cannot be moved to an open tile. Outcrops also block Tharokh and Burrow Grubs. Destroy an Outcrop to open a route.

entries.title: Meteorfall and Crownfire
body: When this attack lands, each unit on a Marked tile takes X damage, and each Marked tile becomes Fire.

Crownfire Bursts each of Vyraketh's Marked Fire tiles, then Vyraketh moves toward you and attacks. The Meteorfall card Marks tiles. At the start of your next turn, each unit on a Marked tile takes damage, and each Marked tile becomes Fire.

entries.title: Hollow Gale
body: Hollow Gale damages each unit within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx, then Pushes each unit hit away.
After each Vaeloryx turn, Gust Pushes each unit 1 tile, then turns a quarter clockwise. Vaeloryx retreats before Eye of the Storm. Leave the area or move closer to take less damage.

entries.title: Gusts and Vortices
body: An area Push or Pull moves each enemy in the area in a straight line away from or toward the source. The source is you or the tile the card names. An enemy at the source of a Pull stays in place.

A Push starts with the farthest enemy. A Pull starts with the nearest enemy. A Collision deals 2 damage per unmoved tile to the moving unit and each blocker hit. Squall Pushes each enemy hit 2 tiles away from you.

entries.title: Swap
body: Trade places with a visible enemy or one of your illusions.

Swap requires Range and line of sight. Choose an enemy that occupies 1 tile. Both units trigger ground and traps on arrival. You collect loot on the arrival tile. Anchored allows Swap. Swap causes no Collision.

entries.title: Stances
body: Active stances appear as badges on your unit.

entries.title: Cleanse
body: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.
Cleanse removes Immobilize or Shock at once. Removing Immobilize or Shock frees you for the rest of this turn, and a Shock cleanse can be played while Shocked.

entries.title: Crystal Mantle
body: Each Crystal Mantle layer prevents damage from 1 direct hit, then breaks. Ground, Collision, traps and Health costs bypass Crystal Mantle.
Each layer extends Iskaldra's Shatterstorm by 1 tile, and Shatterstorm breaks the remaining layers. Crystal Mantle cards give you layers that last until broken or combat ends.

entries.title: Last Eclipse
body: Last Eclipse hits you and your Illusions on Marked tiles, then starts Eclipse for 2 turns.
Night Coil puts out the nearest brazier. Walk or Blink onto a dark brazier's tile to relight that brazier. Light blocks Eclipse's darkness.

entries.title: Veilbound Acolyte
lore: An acolyte who walked into the Umbra and came back wearing it. It serves Noctyrax at the heart of the dark.
It pricks you with needles of shadow from a short distance, then slips away again.

entries.title: Tharokh, the Worldspine
lore: An earth dragon so old that the Worldspine Roots grew around it. Its scales are slabs of bedrock. Outside these walls, kings are crowned on stones said to be its shed scales.

Tharokh sends lines of breaking stone across the room, breathes a wave of Rubble and rakes anything in reach of its claws. Upheaval raises Outcrops from the ground it Marks, and Burrow Grubs fight at its side.

entries.title: Vyraketh, the Cinder Crown
lore: The fire dragon that rules the Cinder Crown. Its scales glow like banked coals. Every hearth in the world above is lit in its name.

Vyraketh rains cinders that Mark the floor and set it burning, breathes flame and bites hard up close. Wildfire spreads its fires to the tiles around them, Crownfire sets off its Marked fires at once, and Cinder Droplets fight at its side.

entries.title: Vaeloryx, the Hollow Gale
lore: The wind dragon of the Hollow Gale, pale as cloud. Its wings never stop moving. Sailors far from here still pour out wine to it before they leave port.

Vaeloryx hooks you from afar and drags you in, dives through anything in its path, and whips up wind that throws back everyone near it. Its Gust shoves units downwind after each of its turns, and Gust Shrikes fly at its side.

entries.title: Iskaldra, the Rime Tyrant
lore: The ice dragon of the Rime Hall, armored in crystal that grows back as fast as it breaks. The north keeps its winters long in Iskaldra's honor.

Iskaldra wraps itself in layers of Crystal Mantle, lances the floor with Ice and claws at close range. Each layer widens Shatterstorm, Frostbite hurts each unit standing on Ice, and Rime Spitters fight at its side.

entries.title: Noctyrax, the Last Eclipse
lore: The dragon at the heart of the Umbra. Its kin wear crowns in the world above. These walls, and everything that walks between them, are its making.

Noctyrax drags you closer with coils of night that snuff out braziers, rakes with its claws and breathes darkness that ignores Block. Its Last Eclipse strikes Marked ground and then swallows the room in dark, and Veilbound Acolytes rise to fight beside it.

entries.title: Ground
body: Place the named ground on each tile in the area.
A tile holds Rubble and 1 of Fire, Ice or Electrified. Ground stays until destroyed, replaced, removed or combat ends.

entries.title: Fire
body: A unit entering Fire takes 2 damage, and a unit starting on Fire takes 3.

entries.title: Ice
body: A unit entering Ice or starting a turn on Ice gains Expose 2.

entries.title: Electrified
body: A Lightning card's hit on an Electrified tile also hits each enemy on connected Electrified tiles.
Electrified tiles also relay Chain. Frost Circuit turns connected Ice tiles into Electrified. Discharge Bursts connected Electrified tiles.

entries.title: Rubble
body: Leaving Rubble costs 2 Movement.
The first step is allowed if you have Movement remaining.

entries.title: Relocate Ground
body: Move the ground on one tile to another open tile.

entries.title: Reflect
body: Attacks from a non-adjacent tile bounce back to the attacker.

entries.title: Flying
body: Flying units ignore traps, ground and Collision damage.

entries.title: Marked
body: Marked tiles show where this enemy will act.
Burrowed enemies cannot be targeted or moved. Area attacks hit Burrowed enemies. A Burrow Grub emerges on the Marked tile or the nearest open tile.

entries.title: Charge
body: At 3 Charge, this enemy's next attack is Arc Lash. Shock removes 1 Charge.
This enemy gains Charge each use. Arc Lash Chains between units.

entries.title: Gust
body: On each Gust beat, each unit is Pushed downwind.
Anchored units stay in place.

entries.title: Upheaval
body: On each Upheaval beat, Marked tiles become Outcrops and move units to free adjacent tiles.
The tile stays flat if the unit cannot be moved. Destroy an Outcrop to open a route.

entries.title: Burst
body: Destroy the target, then deal X damage on that tile and each adjacent tile.
Hover the card to see each tile the Burst hits. Kindle adds up to 4 damage to the Ember Tick's Burst.

entries.title: Range
body: How far this attack reaches in tiles, counted without diagonals.

entries.title: Time
body: Spending Time makes your next turn come later.
A card always costs at least 1 Time.
Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time.

entries.title: Eclipse
body: The darkest Umbra stage, where you see only your tile and each adjacent tile.
Light still reveals tiles.

entries.title: Skate
body: This turn, Ice costs you no Movement and doesn't Expose you.

entries.title: Fireproof
body: This turn, Fire doesn't damage you.

entries.title: Convert Ground
body: Change the chosen ground into the named ground, then damage each enemy on the changed tiles.
The card shows whether connected tiles change too.

entries.title: Swap Illusion
body: Trade places with one of your illusions.
Swap with one of your visible Illusions, anywhere unless the card shows a Range. Both units trigger ground and traps on arrival.

entries.title: Health
body: At 0 Health, a unit is defeated.
Terrain breaks at 0 Health. Your Health carries over between rooms.

entries.title: Groundsplit
body: This enemy damages each unit adjacent to terrain this enemy raised.

entries.title: Crownfire
body: This enemy Bursts the Fire on each tile from this enemy's last Cinder Marks.
Each unit is hit once.

entries.title: Guard Ally
body: This enemy gives X Block to each shown ally.
The enemy may also guard itself.

entries.title: Heal Ally
body: This enemy restores X Health to the named ally.
The target can be this enemy.

entries.title: Embers
body: Currency spent on wares and levels, and dropped when you die.
Earn Embers from kills and victories. Recover dropped Embers on your next run.

entries.title: Fire
body: Fire cards place Fire and Burst that Fire.

entries.title: Ice
body: Ice cards place Ice and Burst that Ice.

entries.title: Lightning
body: Lightning cards place Electrified and spread through Electrified tiles.

entries.title: Air
body: Air cards Push, Pull and move units.

entries.title: Earth
body: Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and give Stoneskin.

entries.title: Skill Point
body: Earned by leveling up and spent on skills.
Spend Skill Points in the Character menu.

entries.title: Moltshards
body: Won from your first dragon, then traded for Embers or spent to reset your skills.
Trade 1 for 250 Embers, or spend 1 to reset your skills.

entries.title: Wait
body: Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time to your next turn.

entries.title: Turns
body: How many of your turns this effect lasts.
At the start of your turn, reduce Turns by 1. The effect ends at 0. An effect marked ∞ lasts for the rest of combat.

entries.title: Movement
body: Tiles you can walk each turn for free.
Walk up to your Movement without spending a Card Play or Time. At the start of your turn, refill your Movement. Base Movement is 2.

entries.title: Item
body: A one-use card from your item slots.
An Item from either of your 2 slots joins your deck and has Consume.

entries.title: Ground Techniques
body: Burst destroys ground and deals damage.

Frost Circuit leaves Electrified on the tile, then deals 2 damage and Shocks the enemy on the tile. On Ice: also on each connected Ice tile. Discharge Bursts the Electrified tile and each connected Electrified tile. Wards leave ground on each adjacent enemy's tile. Ice gives Expose on entry and on turn start.

entries.title: Sweeping Strike
body: Hit each visible enemy that meets the named condition.
Select no target. The condition may require Fire, Ice, Electrified or Light. Each hit is a direct hit. Play the card only if at least 1 enemy qualifies and is within Range.

entries.title: Ember Tick
lore: A tick swollen on the heat of the furnace halls. Fire shows through the cracks in its shell.
It scuttles in to bite. When it dies it Bursts, hurting every unit beside it and leaving Fire, and Kindle makes that Burst stronger.

entries.title: Ember Hoarder
lore: An Ember Tick that has gorged on the Labyrinth's Embers until it can barely run. It sits on its hoard with a brood of Ember Ticks around it.
It keeps its distance and scurries away from you, and Kindle makes the Burst it leaves when it dies stronger. If you don't catch it in time, it slips away with its hoard.

entries.title: Slag Mortar
lore: A squat brute with a furnace bowl strapped to its back, made to shell the halls of the Cinder Crown. It throws its slag without looking where it lands.
It lobs slag that Marks a cross of tiles on you, then lands on its next turn and leaves Fire. It also braces behind Block and fires scattered slag that knocks you back.

entries.title: Ash Hound
lore: A lean, scorched hound bred to run with the Ashen Reaver. Its hide still smoulders.
Ash Hounds run fast and bite, and their Flanking Bite knocks you back a tile.

entries.title: Hoarfrost Seer
lore: A hooded hermit who came north looking for Iskaldra's winter and never left the Rime Hall. It reads the frost the way others read the stars.
It marks the ground at your feet for Icefall, which lands on its next turn and leaves Ice, and its bolts Stagger anyone standing on Ice. It also falls back behind Block.

entries.title: Glacial Mirror
lore: A walking slab of glacier ice with a pane of clear crystal set in its chest. You can see yourself in it, a little colder than you are.

Its Reflect sends attacks made from a distance back at you. It grinds forward slowly, throws a line of refracted cold that Pierces Block and Staggers anyone on Ice, and shields the ally beside it, or itself, with Block.

entries.title: Rime Whelp
lore: A young Rimejaw that has not grown its full spines. Whelps follow the Rimejaw on its hunts.
It closes fast to bite, and its snapping jaws Stagger anyone standing on Ice.

entries.title: Rime Spitter
lore: A squat, pale toad with a throat full of frost. Iskaldra keeps them the way a lord keeps hounds.
It spits a needle of ice down a line that leaves Ice at the far end, and its frost spit Staggers anyone standing on Ice.

entries.title: Arc Thrall
lore: A hulking servant of the Tempest Spire, with an iron collar at its throat and a rod full of lightning in its fist. It has worn that collar so long it has forgotten it is there.
It hurls bolts from its rod that leave the ground Electrified, and up close its jab Shocks you.

entries.title: Storm Capacitor
lore: A jar of storm bound in iron and set into the floor of the Tempest Spire. Something inside it keeps trying to get out.
It never moves. It builds Charge, and at 3 Charge it unleashes Arc Lash, which leaps from unit to unit. Shock drains its Charge.

entries.title: Bell Tender
lore: A hooded bell-ringer of the Broken Choir, masked in brass. It carries the choir's song out across the floor.
It links tiles into Electrified ground for the storm to strike, and fires bolts from its staff.

entries.title: Gale Herald
lore: A herald wrapped in wind-torn banners, still sounding Vaeloryx's call through the Hollow Gale.
It blows its horn to call the wind, fires bolts of wind that knock you back, and stills the air around itself for Block.

entries.title: Gust Shrike
lore: A small, quick hawk of the Hollow Gale. Vaeloryx's wings throw them off like sparks.
It dives in from far off and hits you anywhere along its path, knocking you back. It also rakes with its talons and hovers out of reach behind Block.

entries.title: Roc Fledgling
lore: A young Gallows Roc, not yet grown into its wings. It follows the Roc out of the Hanging Roost to fight.
It darts in close and pecks at you.

entries.title: Burrow Grub
lore: A blind grub as thick as a man, chewing tunnels through the Worldspine Roots. Tharokh's roots are full of them.
It burrows under the floor and marks the tile under you, then erupts there on its next turn, throwing up Rubble and leaving itself Exposed. Above ground, it gnaws.

entries.title: Briar Weaver
lore: A hunched knot of living roots and thorns, grown out of the Worldspine Roots. It tends the Labyrinth's stone the way a gardener tends a hedge.
It Marks lines of floor that later heave up into Outcrops, lashes you with thorns from range and heals its most wounded ally nearby.

entries.title: Stoneback Mite
lore: A stone-shelled mite that lives among the Craghide's plates and follows it out to fight.
It claws at you, and its Driving Claw shoves you back while it braces behind a little Block.

entries.title: Gloam Stalker
lore: A hooded thing with sickles for hands that lives in the Umbra's deepest dark. You rarely see it before it is behind you.
It Fades into the dark and reappears behind you, then strikes from Ambush on its next turn. Otherwise it closes in and slashes.

entries.title: Hollow Mimic
lore: A shadow that has taken on your shape, down to the hair and the armor. The dark down here learns from everyone who walks in it.
It fires bolts of shadow from range. After its Echo, it hits back whenever you strike it up close, until its next turn. It also falls back out of reach.

entries.title: Wick Shade
lore: What is left of someone who lost their way in the dark: a hooded shape with one cold light where a face should be. The Last Lamplighter calls them out of the flames it snuffs.
It drifts toward you and grasps at you to drag you closer. In Last Light, it puts out the braziers you keep lit.

entries.title: Ashen Reaver
lore: An executioner in blackened plate, made to hold the Cinder Yard on the road to Vyraketh. Its falchion still glows from a forge no one has lit in an age.

The Reaver rakes the ground with lines of Fire and sweeps its falchion across the tiles in front of it, and its heaviest blow leaves it Exposed. Wildfire spreads its flames toward you every other turn.

entries.title: Rimejaw
lore: A long, pale beast with a bare skull for a face and spines of ice down its back. It hunts the Broken Rime on the road to Iskaldra.
It leaves Ice in its tracks and pounces from a distance, and its heavier bites Stagger anyone standing on Ice. Frostbite Staggers each unit on Ice after each of your turns.

entries.title: Storm Cantor
lore: A gilded figure that leads the Broken Choir on the road to Zekarion. It sings the hymns people above still sing to the storm, and down here the storm answers.
The Cantor lays chains of Electrified ground across the room, then its Peal strikes everyone standing on that ground. Up close it brings its staff down hard, and it calls Lightning Wisps to its side.

entries.title: Gallows Roc
lore: A vulture the size of a cart, with charms and gallows rope tangled in its feathers. It nests in the Hanging Roost on the road to Vaeloryx.
It hooks you from afar and drags you closer, beats its razor wings to throw you back, and dives on you from above. After each of your turns, its Gust blows across the room.

entries.title: Craghide
lore: A bear grown over with plates of rock, sleeping off the centuries in the Shattered Burrow on the road to Tharokh. It does not like to be woken.
Every other turn, it heaves Marked floor up into Outcrops. It cracks the ground around that stone to hurt you if you stand near it, and charges in for a crushing blow.

entries.title: Last Lamplighter
lore: The last keeper of the Labyrinth's braziers, still making its rounds at the Last Watch on the road to Noctyrax. Every flame it snuffs leaves the dark a little deeper.

It snuffs braziers and calls up a Wick Shade when none is left, hooks you closer with its lantern chain and walks its Last Procession in to strike. After each of your turns, hidden Wick Shades step toward you through the dark.
